details.name: Printing the Squares of Numbers Within a Specified Range (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program to write out the squares of even positive integers less than or equal to 10.

details.name: Printing the Squares of Numbers Within a Specified Range (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program to write out the squares of odd positive integers less than 10.

details.name: Printing the Squares of Numbers Within a Specified Range (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program to write out the squares of every number between 20 and 25, both inclusive.
